whyThisFilenameAndNotRowsJson: data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/pf02/rows.json and rows.pf02-rhode-island-2026-09-05.json are earlier PF02 returns and are not overwritten. This shift also does not overwrite this lane's previous Delaware return; it is a separate file under a name unique to this branch and this cohort.
whatThisShiftReversed: The previous PF02 shift stopped all three Delaware families as BLOCKED_SOURCE on AES-256 encryption, concluding that this factory holds no code path that could build from an encrypted source. Every measurement in that return holds -- the four Delaware binaries really are AES-256 (V=5, R=6, StdCF), pdf-lib really has no security handler, and ignoreEncryption:true really does parse ciphertext and surface as "Expected instance of PDFDict, but got instance of undefined" -- but the conclusion was wrong. The factory solved this in early September: renderStrategy pikepdf_unlocked_derivative_then_official_form_finalizer, proven on five encrypted California forms in scripts/build-census-v1-ca-1203-4-set.mjs and carried to a terminal family on Maine's encrypted CR-218 in scripts/build-census-v1-me-seal-gen-set.mjs. Two of the three Delaware families are built on that pattern in this return.

familyExplicitlyNotBuilt.why: Left stopped on the previous shift's finding, which the Captain did not override: FORM-281 is a binary .doc and FORM-281E a .docx with legacy FORMTEXT/FORMCHECKBOX fields, the family binds no PDF at all, and Delaware Family Court publishes the whole family as Word. That needs an owner decision on a Word path, not a rescue. Nothing was built and nothing was converted.

Its digest appears in no committed source record and in no corpus-index entry. setsNoVerdict: This lane does not verify its own packets. No PASS is issued here, rasterState is BUILT_RASTER_PENDING, and RASTER_PASS comes from the central workflow bound to the exact SHA-256 recorded in each row.
